name: Gothic Royalty & Spooky Crowns
label: Hands-on workshop
description:
Enter the realm of gothic royalty. A place not only for the dark and shadowy, but one filled with opulent decadence.
In this playful and imaginative workshop, discover just how sophisticated a pipe cleaner can be. Building from an all black foundation, you'll style your one-of-a-kind crown with rich reds, gemstone greens, and vibrant purples by adding jewels, dramatic details, miniature bones, or whatever inspires your inner monarch. 
No matter which way your style leans from spooky, to gloriously over-the-top, you’ll create a crown that reflects you. Crowns can be worn as part of a costume, as a statement piece for a special event, or simply crown yourself because you can.
Come see a humble craft supply in a whole new way—and leave wearing your own piece of gothic royalty.
